study_identification_part.si_4_title: Neurodevelopmental model of schizophrenia revisited: similarity in individual deviation and idiosyncrasy from the normative model of whole-brain white matter tracts and shared brain-cognition covariation with ADHD and ASD

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Single-site recruitment at National Taiwan University Hospital; includes TDC and schizophrenia/ASD/ADHD groups.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The three patient groups were recruited from the Department of Psychiatry, National Taiwan University Hospital... We recruited TDC from the same community of the patient groups"

answer.SINGLE-SITE: Normative model training on typically developing controls; clinical comparison cohorts for schizophrenia, ASD, ADHD.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: TDCs used to construct sex-specific normative age models of GFA; patient groups used for deviation/idiosyncrasy analyses.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Individualized tract-deviation profiles comprised GFA Z-scores... constructed from 626 TDCs... Individual deviations from the norm... were then determined for around 300 individuals with schizophrenia, 300 with ADHD, and 200 with ASD."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Chien2022.pdf.md: Statistical analysis, standardized normative models

model-1.model-name: Sex-specific normative age model of WM GFA

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Normative model constructed from TDCs; training/validation split not reported.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Individualized tract-deviation profiles comprised GFA Z-scores of each WM tract derived from the sex-specific normative age models, constructed from 626 TDCs"
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Chien2022.pdf.md: Statistical analysis, standardized normative models
